_note: Seeded from the existing term bank (Kolosalio Lea mo hono 'Uhinga, Agriculture section by Viliami). Only a sample of ~10 of the ~48 available entries is included here to demonstrate the schema. The glottal stop (fakau'a) has NOT yet been normalized across entries in the source document — treat every to_term/to_definition here as needing a native-speaker pass before this leaves template status.

entries.en_definition: The practice of cultivating soil, growing crops, and raising animals for food, fiber, and other products.
entries.to_definition: Ko e faahinga ngaue ki hono teuteu'i e kelekele, to e ngoue moe tauhi monumanu kihe me'atokoni, naunau moe ngaahi me'a kehe.

entries.en_definition: The science of soil management and crop production.
entries.to_definition: Koe faahinga 'ilo moe founga ki hono tokangaekina e kelekele moe to e ngoue.

entries.en_definition: Planting different crops in a planned sequence on the same land to maintain soil fertility and reduce pests.
entries.to_definition: Koe to fetongitongi e ngoue 'ihe feitu'u tatau ke pukepuke e kelekele mo fakasi'si'i e fili e ngoue.

entries.en_definition: A substance (organic or chemical) added to soil to supply nutrients for plant growth.
entries.to_definition: Koe fa'ahinga fafanga ngaohi pe fakanatula 'oku tanaki kihe kelekele kene fafanga e tupu 'ae 'akau.

entries.en_definition: Supplying water to crops through artificial means (e.g., canals, sprinklers, drip systems).
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fu'ifu'i e ngoue 'aki ha founga a e tangata hange ko hono fakatafe, pe me'afu'ifu'i fana pe to'ito'i.

entries.en_definition: Farming without synthetic chemicals, focusing on natural fertilizers and pest control.
entries.to_definition: Ko faama 'oku 'ikai ngaue'aki ha fafanga ngaohi, kae fakatefito pe he fafanga fakanatula moe mapule'i e fili e ngoue.

entries.en_definition: Using a plough to cut and turn over the upper layer of soil before planting.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono palau e kelekele ke fulihi mo fakamolu e kelekele pea toki to e ngoue.

entries.en_definition: Practices to maintain or improve soil health, fertility, and structure.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha ngaahi ngaue ke pukepuke mo fakalelei'i e mo'ui a e kelekele, fafanga moe hono fa'unga.

entries.en_definition: Methods to prevent or control damage to crops from diseases, insects, and other pests.
entries.to_definition: Founga ke fakafepaki pe mapule'i aki e maumau ngaahi fili e ngoue.

entries.en_definition: Efficient use and conservation of water resources for farming.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono ngaue'aki fakapotopoto mo fakasi'isi'i e maumau vai kihe ngoue.
